## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Patti, Italy. It starts at Via Papa Giovanni XXIII, 2.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Villa Romana di Patti could have been lost to time! It was only rediscovered in 1973 thanks to work on the highway, but it covers a whopping 20,000 square meters.
>
> Explore the ancient Romans' deep infatuation with mosaics firsthand – some of the treasures still hold their original coloring from the 4th century AD.
>
> You'll also be able to see ceramics, fragments of inscriptions, carved bone items, and structures from the earlier villa between the 1st and 2nd century AD.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.69. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
